evidence.g2_failure_step: Verify exact F2 and donor source identities

finding: The legacy F2-WP-105 G2 workflow fails on the G4 PR before compilation or behavioral tests because it pins the exact superseded G2 adapter/test blobs. The same G4 head passes the dedicated G4 structural-provenance workflow. Therefore the red G2 run is stale successor-hash-pin evidence, not evidence that the G4 behavior failed.
risk: Leaving the historical G2 workflow as a mandatory path-triggered exact-old-blob gate can create a permanent false-red condition for every legitimate successor generation touching the adapter/test surfaces. Silently deleting it would lose historical reproducibility. The workflow needs successor-aware retirement/dispatch semantics, not reinterpretation of the failed run as product logic evidence.
recommended_discriminator: Before G4 reconciliation, classify the G2 workflow explicitly as historical/superseded for successor generations or introduce a successor-dynamic gate that resolves the active admitted generation instead of requiring G2 blob identities. Preserve the original G2 workflow/run as historical reproducibility evidence.
credit_boundary: No real external effect, target runtime, VPS, physical GRID10, GWT, training, completion, canonical-semantics-promotion or whole-system credit is created by this review.
